text:
maya_cs: Quick kickoff at 2pm PT today to align HelioHealth onboarding: owners, must-have success criteria, immediate risks, and short timeline. Who's in?
jordan_pm: I'm in. I'll own product acceptance + sign-off criteria.
kelsey_csm: Count me in for renewal/watch tracking. We should tag renewal risk early.
olivia_success: I can run enablement + API walkthrough. Proposed success criteria: integration tests >= 90% pass, sample traffic hitting SLA, basic observability in Console.
sam_se: I'll prepare sample payloads and infra checklist. Flag: they asked for 12mo retention + PHI considerations. Need to confirm whether pilot can be hosted or needs Private.
li_eng: SSO is needed for GA only; SSO ETA ~2 weeks. For pilot we can do token-based or hosted with PHI blackout. I'll put SSO task in the board.
maya_cs: Timeline proposal: smoke tests within 48h, internal pilot end of week, customer pilot week after. Kelsey: renewal window in ~11 months; let's plan a QBR at month 8 with usage/ops summary.
jordan_pm: Action items: @sam_se -> upload sample payloads to s3://rw-helio/samples by 10am tomorrow; @li_eng -> confirm SSO rollout ETA in JIRA; @olivia_success -> schedule 30m enablement + share test prompts. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
olivia_success: Scheduling 30m (15m demo + 15m Qs). I'll post Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/helio-onboard (WIP). I'll also create a 5-question feedback form to post after demo.
calendar-bot: Event created: "HelioHealth onboarding kickoff" at 14:00 PT. Attendees: maya_cs, jordan_pm, olivia_success, sam_se, li_eng, kelsey_csm.
sam_se: :thumbsup: I'll put payloads at s3://rw-helio/samples and leave a README with curl examples.
li_eng: Risk logged: "SSO delay". Fallback plan: token auth for pilot. Also flag: "PHI_handling" -> we need Data Processing Agreement confirmed.
kelsey_csm: I'll own renewal tracking and will add a renewal risk scorecard to the ticket. Suggest adding a customer checklist for success metrics (ops + product).
maya_cs: Draft quick acceptance checklist (will push to Confluence and formalize):
```
- smoke_tests: green
- latency_p95 < 350ms
- integration_tests >= 90%
- docs_shared: true
- first_week_usage_reported
```

jordan_pm: Also adding non-functional: monitoring alerts configured, cost baseline captured, fallback model pinned.
olivia_success: After the enablement I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + survey link here. Plan: daily 10min standups for first 5 business days to triage issues and capture feedback.
maya_cs: Great. I'll send a 1-pager to the exec sponsor and kick off the standup series. Thanks team :rocket:
